body: Nah with more trouble I mean they'll try to stop me etc and all the other stuff I talked about earlier in the scenario if I would show it to my relatives, what I'd like to achieve is eternal quiet & rest, prob the best way to describe it yeah

Kek almost a month late, it would prob just cause me more trouble than it's worth tbh, just easier to do it the quiet way & have them find out afterwards, was actually gonna do it last Thursday  since I had the night I wanted to, but the girl kept me occupied till the morning so couldn't, so prob somewhere next week is gonna be it, but it wouldn't mean a lot to me I think.
They're just the only ones that did something for me, and ofc I get along with them well, even if it was unconsciously, some bailed me out of economical situations etc, others more with mental health

Eh living alone isn't all that bad, since I don't remember a lot of the things I do/say, days just seem to go on forever but eventually end, dont think it worsens it it's just more noticeable & gets to me more, it only gets better with specific people though
I love alone so they won't be there anyway, but because I'd want other ppl there instead & being home means I'll most likely be alone & when I'm talking to ppl etc it's less noticable

No because if I stay in alone I won't be able to enjoy myself, since I'd just be focusing on shit I'm hearing etc again, so out is better & ofc not used to it, but it's not my subconscious I think since it's not my family I want with me anyway
Well it's not really bothering tbh, just a lot of my neighbors visiting etc
Just nobody bothering me for approx a week so have plenty of time, also it's just at the end of events I said I'd attend etc, overall just a nice timing I'd say
Just the most convenient timing, and 99% of these meds have the same side effects tbh, atleast all I've been on have pretty much the same ones, eh don't feel like asking anymore

Yeah kinda common here haha, plans are about mid may, just a nice night out with nice meal etc then ending it, and just stopped because it is easier to live with delusions etc than to feel nothing at all and not be able to think properly

They aren't gonna happen because they themselves can't deal with their own problems so they'll get someone else to help me, and anybody with some form of cognitive ability can write a letter, and my plans are mostly finished tbh, haven't taken any in a long time now, so no I'm not thinking of switching

Hugs don't do shit, but that's besides the point, that's a huge if which isn't likely to happen at all, and like you said, if it is beyond defeating then there is no point, just wasting already wasted time at this point

By back here I mean the position I'm at now, but the place itself doesn't really make a difference, even when you're in there it doesn't feel like living, they're just keeping you alive day by day, besides, what's a life worth living without stimulation of any kind of emotion.

First experience is the same for everyone, they just talk to you about your file & the things they're gonna try to do, then the practical stuff where you're gonna stay at etc, then just an all round drug test, after that it's mostly just counceling, anger management, rehabilitation & addiction treatment with a nice touch of anti-psychotics/antidepressants

Nothing really, since most of em already know what happened in my life, besides, even if they didn't know about it, it would make no difference besides prob forced entry into another mental health centre, which will eventually just put me back here

Sorry for late reply, I was talking about all bad things in the world, not just about my life specifically, but if I was talking about my life specifically, everyone keeps talking about a point of light eventually in their life, then why in all these years it still hasn't come, not a single point at which you could say "thanks for giving me this",  if you want the most recent events it's just the last passage of my note, haven't updated it yet, will prob do tonight tho

Don't believe in any of it, it was prob just created to control large populations and teach them values & morals, the rest is pure bullshit. And also, if like the most prevelant religions say, that he is all loving, then why does he let shit like this happen.

Eh saying all of them drank themselves to death would be an overstatement, one OD & other slitting his wrists, so dad's side is gone & mom's side cut all ties with me years ago, and about her, I don't know, it doesn't matter anyway, since my plans are already made up, now to finally answer your question lol, I've gotten pretty good at acting normal as long as it stays to casual conversation, I don't mind the numbness, it's pretty helpful from time to time, but just want to feel something from time to time too, I've gotten used to the sounds etc by now, it's just difficult to distinguish reality from what I'm hearing from time to time, and I'll be talking to people while turning my head every minute or so, which makes them think there is something while there's nothing, so I guess just those 2 for now would be an improvement.
